scripts.prepare:reader: tsc -p tsconfig.reader.json && node scripts/prepare-reader.ts && node scripts/build-card-art.ts
scripts.prebuild: npm run prepare:reader && tsc -p tsconfig.edge.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.reader.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.edge.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json
